description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) enhancement EAGLE'S EYE (Guardians of the Throne, WP-C46): +1 W; (once per battle, per army) when attacks are allocated to this model, it can have a 3+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase. Fixture ork11e_o34_active (P1 Orks active, P2 Custodes); setup privileges: P2 detachment Guardians of the Throne, Blade Champion Alpha given Eagle's Eye through the list-build pass (W 7 -> 8, as the army builder would), CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation. Fight phase: both Pile In halves passed, a real click selects the Meganobz (engaged with the Blade Champion), all Power Klaw attacks at it; the Custodes player's enemy_targets_unit_fight window shows the free EAGLE'S EYE card; a real click uses it (no CP); the attacks resolve and the Blade Champion's save rolls against 3+ INVULNERABLE (the Power Klaw's AP would leave its armour at 4+); the enhancement is spent for the battle.

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["2"]["detachment"] = "Guardians of the Throne"
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
var u = GameState.state.units["U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"]
u.meta["enhancements"] = ["Eagle's Eye"]
load("res://scripts/codex/custodes/CustodesEnhancements.gd").apply_list_build("U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A", u)
return "%d %d" % [int(u.meta.stats.wounds), int(u.models[0].current_wounds)]

steps.comment: the Orks' unit_selected_to_fight window (not under test)
re-opened window (nothing else usable at 0 CP)
the Blade Champion's save rolled against the 3+ invulnerable save
